result.stdout:
USAGE:
    sigaba [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    init           Sets up the initial configuration                     
    encrypt        Encrypts all files defined in the configuration       
    decrypt        Decrypts all files defined in the configuration       
    edit <file>    Opens the specified file and encrypts it after editing

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Sets up the initial configuration

USAGE:
    sigaba init [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
    -q, --quiet                  (Optional) No console output. Same as verbosity
                                 level Quiet                                    
        --verbosity              (Optional) Sets the verbosity level (Detailed, 
                                 Normal, Quiet). Default: Normal                
    -n, --non-interactive        (Optional) Runs the command in non-interactive 
                                 mode                                           
    -p, --password <PASSWORD>    (Required in non-interactive mode) Sets the    
                                 password to decrypt the private key            
        --no-logo                (Optional) Disables the display of the logo

DESCRIPTION:
Decrypts all files defined in the configuration

USAGE:
    sigaba decrypt [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                       Prints help information                    
    -q, --quiet                      (Optional) No console output. Same as      
                                     verbosity level Quiet                      
        --verbosity                  (Optional) Sets the verbosity level        
                                     (Detailed, Normal, Quiet). Default: Normal 
    -p, --password <PASSWORD>        The password to decrypt the private key    
    -k, --private-key-file <PATH>    (Optional) The path to the private key     
                                     file. If none provided, the path will be   
                                     inferred (see docs)
